spec.description: A named store-and-auth bundle. Pods reference it by name instead of repeating endpoint and auth annotations.

source.description: Which store speaks at the other end: etcd, consul, vault or config-server.

tokenSecret.description: A Secret in this namespace holding the token, when the store wants one; its `token` key is what the agent receives.

openAPIV3Schema.title: DynamicConfigClass

openAPIV3Schema.description: Auto-generated derived type for ClusterDynamicConfigClassSpec via `CustomResource`

spec.description: The cluster-scoped class: the platform team defines stores (and holds their credentials) ONCE, and tenant namespaces reference them by name without ever seeing a credential. The credential Secret lives in an explicitly named namespace, and `namespaces` is the allowlist that keeps "global" from meaning "anyone".

namespaces.description: Namespaces whose Renders may use this class. Absent means every namespace — say so on purpose, not by omission.

source.description: Which store speaks at the other end.

tokenSecret.description: The credential, when the store wants one — with the namespace it lives in named explicitly, because a cluster-scoped object has no namespace of its own to default to.

key.description: The key inside the Secret; `token` by default.

openAPIV3Schema.description: Auto-generated derived type for DynamicConfigRenderSpec via `CustomResource`

spec.description: A store document reconciled into a ConfigMap, for workloads that cannot take a sidecar.

classKind.description: `DynamicConfigClass` (default, this namespace) or `ClusterDynamicConfigClass` split between a namespaced store and a platform-owned one.

key.description: The document's key in the store.

target.description: The ConfigMap to write, and the file name inside it (its extension picks the rendered format).

configMap.description: The ConfigMap to write. Exactly one of `configMap` and `secret`.

file.description: The file name inside the target (its extension picks the rendered format). Required for the `file` shape; unused for `envEntries`, where the keys ARE the entries.

secret.description: The Secret to write — for consumers that read Kubernetes Secrets natively. Secret updates are live objects: a watcher reacts without any pod restart, and an `envFrom` consumer picks them up on its next start — environment variables freeze at container start, which is Kubernetes' rule rather than this operator's.

shape.description: `file` (default): one rendered document under `file`'s name. `envEntries`: every leaf, dotted paths upper-snaked (`db.pool_size` → `DB_POOL_SIZE`) — the shape `envFrom` consumes. `entries`: every leaf VERBATIM (`auth.postgres-password` stays so) — for Secret keys some other chart already named, the `existingSecret` contract.

conditions.description: The k8s-native shape of the two fields above: one `Ready` condition, so `kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready` and every conditions-reading tool work here the way they work everywhere.

items.description: `metav1.Condition`'s fields, spelled locally so the CRD schema stays generated from this crate's types like everything else.

lastError.description: The last failure, kind and path only — never a value, the same redaction rule as everywhere else in the organisation.

renderedAt.description: The last generation successfully rendered, and when.
